question: Can you use CytoConverter genomic coordinates to calculate the frequency of chromosomal gains and losses across a cohort of breast cancer (morphology='3111') and adenocarcinoma (topology='0401') samples? Concretely, please include the number and frequency (2 decimals in percentage) of amplifications (gains of more than 1 copy), gains (1 extra copy), losses (1 copy) and homozygous deletions (loss of 2 copies) for each chromosomal band. And sort the result by the ordinal of each chromosome and the starting-ending base-pair position of each band in ascending order.
sql:
-- Final query with all four categories
-- Using CytoBands_hg38 to define chromosomal bands
-- Mapping "Gain" to "gains" and "Loss" to "losses"
-- "amplifications" and "homozygous_deletions" are 0
-- Frequency is calculated as percentage of total events per band, rounded to 2 decimals

SELECT 
    cb.chromosome,
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start as band_start,
    cb.hg38_stop as band_end,
    0 as amplifications,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gains,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses,
    0 as homozygous_deletions,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as gain_freq,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as loss_freq
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  ON cb.chromosome = cc.Chr
  AND cc.Start >= cb.hg38_start
  AND cc.Start < cb.hg38_stop
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cg 
  ON cc.RefNo = cg.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = cg.CaseNo
WHERE cg.Morph = '3111' OR cg.Topo = '0401'
GROUP BY cb.chromosome, cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY cb.chromosome, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop

-- Using CytoBands_hg38 to define chromosomal bands
-- Mapping "Gain" to "gains" and "Loss" to "losses"

SELECT 
    cb.chromosome,
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start as band_start,
    cb.hg38_stop as band_end,
    0 as amplifications,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gains,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses,
    0 as homozygous_deletions,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as gain_freq,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as loss_freq
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  ON cb.chromosome = cc.Chr
